title: Courtyard that is the only daylight source to a habitable room is uncovered and at least 4m2
text: Windows and openings (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C2.2.1 Where a courtyard is the only source of daylight to a habitable room, the courtyard must be uncovered and open to the sky(1) with a: i. minimum area of 4m2 (refer Figure 2.2a). (1) Excludes minor projections.

notes: diverges: coding R30 and above plus R100-SL (Chapter 3 heading p16 'applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only'; Chapter 2 starts at R50). LR/MR/HR are assessed at R80 standards. Figure 2.2a is still captioned '(multiple dwellings)' and shows a 0.5 x wall height dimension left over from Part C. 'Open to the sky' excludes minor projections (footnote 1).
